$comment: Green-on-arrival baseline: tests that were ALREADY failing before any factory agent ran.
The gate compares CURRENT failure identities against this list — new identities fail the
gate; identities listed here are absorbed; a listed identity that now PASSES is reported
informationally so the fixing PR can delete it from this file.
RULES: (1) The gate reads this file from the BASE REF, never the ticket branch — an agent
cannot whitelist its own breakage. (2) Only REMOVING entries is ever legitimate on a ticket
branch. (3) Identities are '<repo-relative file>::<full test name>'.
STATE: pre-scaffold. The repo has no test suite, so the baseline is empty by definition,
not by measurement. The scaffold ticket must re-measure on its branch (expected: still
empty — a greenfield suite that arrives red should be fixed, not quarantined) and record
